title: Iteration of the encoded loop step
statement: Let $f$ be a function from bit strings to bit strings, and let $c,d$ be bit strings. After applying the loop step $i$ times to the pair encoding of $c$ and $d$, the result is the pair encoding of the suffix of $c$ after deleting its first $i$ bits and the result of applying $f$ repeatedly to $d$ exactly $mathrm{min}(i,|c|)$ times.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps bit strings to bit strings
